text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens. 2. Applicants must be in good health (free from infectious diseases and any physical or mental conditions that could hinder normal study), abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as XDU's rules and regulations, and respect Chinese social morality and customs. 3. Applicants must be at least 18 years old. 4.Applicants must meet the requirements stipulated in the Ministry of Education Document JiaoWaiHan [2020] No. 12. 4. Language Proficiency Requirements：① IELTS (Academic): Overall 6.0 or above (with no band score below 5.5 in Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking). ② TOEFL: 80 points or above. ③ Duolingo English Test: 110 points or above. ④ Cambridge International A Level English subject: Grade A.⑤ Cambridge English Qualifications: FCE (≥169) or CAE (≥ 180) or CPE. 5. CSCA Exam Subjects：Mathematics, Physics.
